Name: Dawn's Bloom
Desc4: Increases Basic Attack DMG by 20%. When equipped by an Attack character, using an EX Special Attack or Ultimate will further increase Basic Attack DMG by 20% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Story: Years after the fall of the old capital, an aging singer who had long since put down the pen released this album. According to the artist, its inspiration came from a hazy, childlike lullaby heard while hiding in the ruins during that catastrophe — on the verge of breaking down.
